english: Old age has finally caught up with you and you decide to abdicate rule.
chinese: 岁月终究不饶人，你决定退位让贤。

english: Terrible news:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Coniving rivals have overthrown you in a coup![NEWLINE]A little to much "Let them eat cake" perhaps?
chinese: 噩耗：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]阴谋家们发动政变推翻了你！[NEWLINE]也许是“何不食肉糜”说得太多了？

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]However, there is good news![NEWLINE]Mystical advisors report that you will be reincarnated and return to power in %d turns.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]In the meantime, you can only hope your successor proves worthy.
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]不过还有好消息！[NEWLINE]神秘的顾问预言，你将于%d回合后转世重生、重掌大权。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在此期间，你只能寄望于继任者堪当此任。

english: When checked, PieceOfMind's ACO shows more detailed combat odds information when you hover over a unit to attack.
chinese: 勾选后，当你悬停在要攻击的单位上时，PieceOfMind 的 ACO 会显示更详细的战斗胜率信息。

english: When checked, shows debugging information in the combat odds calculations.
chinese: 勾选后，在战斗胜率计算中显示调试信息。

english: When checked, shows the original odds in addition to ACO's.
chinese: 勾选后，在 ACO 胜率之外额外显示原始胜率。

english: When checked, ignores any free wins versus barbarians you have left due to the difficulty level.
chinese: 勾选后，忽略你因难度等级而对蛮族尚余的任何免费胜利。

english: When checked, swaps the normal and alternate views.
chinese: 勾选后，交换常规视图与备用视图。

english: When checked, merges the bars of probabilities that are less than half of one percent.
chinese: 勾选后，合并概率小于百分之零点五的条形。

english: When checked, displays "attacker" and "defender" labels before each non-empty set of modifiers.
chinese: 勾选后，在每组非空修正前显示“攻击方”和“防御方”标签。

english: Select when to show the basic odds information.
chinese: 选择何时显示基础胜率信息。

english: Select when to show the attacking unit's information.
chinese: 选择何时显示攻击单位的信息。

english: Select when to show the defending unit's information.
chinese: 选择何时显示防御单位的信息。

english: Select when to show the odds that each unit will survive.
chinese: 选择何时显示各单位的存活几率。

english: Select when to show the odds that each unit will survive without taking any damage.
chinese: 选择何时显示各单位毫发无损存活的几率。

english: Select when to show the average (expected) health each unit will have after the battle.
chinese: 选择何时显示战斗后各单位的平均（预期）生命值。

english: Select when to show the probability bars of each possible ending health for the attacker.
chinese: 选择何时显示攻击方每种可能剩余生命值的概率条。

english: Select when to show the probability bars of each possible ending health for the defender.
chinese: 选择何时显示防御方每种可能剩余生命值的概率条。

english: Select when to show the unrounded XP values in addition to the actual rounded values the units will gain.
chinese: 选择何时在单位实际获得的取整值之外，额外显示未取整的经验值。

english: Select when to show the R values on either side of the actual value that will produce +/- 1 XP.
chinese: 选择何时在实际值两侧显示会导致经验值 +/- 1 的 R 值。

english: Select when to show the defense modifiers.
chinese: 选择何时显示防御修正。

english: Select when to show the total defense modifiers (includes attacker's non-combat modifiers that apply to the defender).
chinese: 选择何时显示总防御修正（含攻击方作用于防御方的非战斗修正）。

english: Select when to show the instructions for pressing [SHIFT] to see the alternate view.
chinese: 选择何时显示按 [SHIFT] 查看备用视图的提示。

english: When checked, minor civilizations are shown (some scenarios consider certain civs to be minor).
chinese: 勾选后，显示次要文明（某些剧本会将特定文明视为次要文明）。

english: When checked, dead civilizations will remain on the scoreboard.
chinese: 勾选后，已灭亡的文明将继续留在记分板上。

english: When checked, dead civilizations will be tagged as "DEAD" when shown.
chinese: 勾选后，已灭亡的文明在显示时会被标记为“已亡”。

english: When checked, dead civilizations will be greyed out when not shown.
chinese: 勾选后，未显示的已灭亡文明会以灰色显示。

english: When checked, shows the change in score since the previous turn
chinese: 勾选后，显示自上一回合以来的分数变化

english: When checked, includes the current turn's change in the score change.
chinese: 勾选后，分数变化中包含当前回合的变化。

english: Determines how civilizations are labeled on the scoreboard.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Leader[COLOR_REVERT] - Name of the leader or player (Victoria or EmperorFool).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Civilization[COLOR_REVERT] - Name of the civilization (England).[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Description[COLOR_REVERT] - Descriptive name of the civilization (English Empire).
chinese: 决定文明在记分板上的标注方式。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]领袖[COLOR_REVERT] - 领袖或玩家的名称（如 Victoria 或 EmperorFool）。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]文明[COLOR_REVERT] - 文明名称（如 England）。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]描述[COLOR_REVERT] - 文明的描述性名称（如 English Empire）。

english: When checked, the human players' names are used in place of those of the leaders they are playing as.
chinese: 勾选后，以人类玩家的名称替代其所扮演领袖的名称。

english: When checked, shows faces depicting each AI's attitude toward you.
chinese: 勾选后，显示描绘各 AI 对你态度的表情。

english: When checked, shows an angry person icon when you are an AI's worst enemy.
chinese: 勾选后，当你是某 AI 的头号大敌时，显示一个愤怒的人像图标。

english: When checked, shows an orange fist icon when the AI is mobilizing for war (We Have Enough on Our Hands).
chinese: 勾选后，当 AI 正为战争进行动员时，显示一个橙色拳头图标（We Have Enough on Our Hands）。

english: When checked, shows a count of the number of cities for each leader.
chinese: 勾选后，显示各领袖的城市数量。

english: When checked, the scoreboard is drawn as a grid, and the other options in this column affect it.
chinese: 勾选后，记分板以网格形式绘制，本列中的其他选项将对其生效。

english: Select the maximum number of civilizations to display (0 for unlimited).
chinese: 选择要显示的最大文明数量（0 表示不限）。

english: Select the height of each civilization's line (default value is 22).
chinese: 选择每个文明所占行的高度（默认值为 22）。

english: The spacing between columns (in pixels) to use when none is specified for a column.
chinese: 当某列未指定间距时所使用的列间距（以像素为单位）。

english: When checked, vassals are group together under their master(s).
chinese: 勾选后，附庸会被归组到其宗主之下。

english: When checked, the civ/leader name is left-aligned instead of right-aligned.
chinese: 勾选后，文明／领袖名称改为左对齐而非右对齐。

english: When checked, shows icons instead of names for civs whose research you can see.
chinese: 勾选后，对研究可见的文明，以图标代替名称显示。

english: Select the size of the research icons when displayed (default value is 24).
chinese: 选择研究图标显示时的大小（默认值为 24）。

english: When checked, shows the ratio of your power rating to those of civilizations with whom you have an embassy (only available with the Advanced Tactics option).
chinese: 勾选后，显示你的实力评分与已互设使馆的文明之间的比率（仅在启用高级战术选项时可用）。

english: Select the formula to use for calculating the power ratio:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Rival vs. You[COLOR_REVERT] - Lower numbers are better.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]You vs. Rival[COLOR_REVERT] - Higher numbers are better.
chinese: 选择用于计算实力比率的公式：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]对手 vs. 你[COLOR_REVERT] - 数值越低越好。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]你 vs. 对手[COLOR_REVERT] - 数值越高越好。

english: Number of decimal places to show for power ratio display.
chinese: 实力比率显示的小数位数。

english: Color used by default for power ratios.
chinese: 实力比率默认使用的颜色。

english: Power ratings greater than or equal to this value are shown in the High Color.
chinese: 大于或等于此值的实力评分以“高比率颜色”显示。

english: Color used for high power ratios.
chinese: 用于高实力比率的颜色。

english: Power ratings less than or equal to this value are shown in in the Low Color.
chinese: 小于或等于此值的实力评分以“低比率颜色”显示。

english: Color used for low power ratios.
chinese: 用于低实力比率的颜色。

english: When checked, a saved game is created after (re)generating the map.
chinese: 勾选后，在（重新）生成地图后创建一个存档。

english: When checked, a saved game is created when the game is won/lost.
chinese: 勾选后，在游戏胜利／失败时创建一个存档。

english: When checked, a saved game is created when you exit using the menu's EXIT TO DESKTOP or EXIT TO MENU commands. [COLOR_YELLOW]The game is not saved automatically if you press ALT + F4.[COLOR_REVERT]
chinese: 勾选后，当你通过菜单的“退出到桌面”或“退出到主菜单”命令退出时创建一个存档。[COLOR_YELLOW]若按 ALT + F4，游戏不会自动保存。[COLOR_REVERT]

english: When checked, your player name is used for the saved game name along with the turn year. Otherwise the name is a concatenation of 3-letter versions of Leader Name, Difficulty, Map Size, Map Type, Speed, Era, Year, Climate and Sea Level. This setting does not affect MapFinder saves.
chinese: 勾选后，存档名称使用你的玩家名称并附带回合年份。否则名称由领袖名、难度、地图大小、地图类型、速度、时代、年份、气候和海平面各取 3 个字母拼接而成。此设置不影响 MapFinder 存档。

english: When checked, various game events are logged to a text file using eotinb's AutoLog mod.
chinese: 勾选后，使用 eotinb 的 AutoLog 模组将各类游戏事件记录到文本文件。

english: When checked, the logger is automatically started and doesn't wait for the manual start (or stop) command which can be issued by using [Alt + L].
chinese: 勾选后，记录器自动启动，无需等待手动开始（或停止）命令；该命令可通过 [Alt + L] 发出。

english: When checked, the default (playername.txt) will be used, ignores log file name option.
chinese: 勾选后，将使用默认文件名（playername.txt），并忽略日志文件名选项。

english: Directory where log file resides (fully qualified path, i.e. C:\\folder\\subfolder or blank).
chinese: 日志文件所在目录（完整限定路径，如 C:\\folder\\subfolder，或留空）。

english: Name of log file. If there is no file of this name in the directory above, one will be created.
chinese: 日志文件名。若上述目录中不存在此名称的文件，将新建一个。

english: The format of the log output.
Plain|HTML Tags|Forum Tags, With " around color codes|Forum Tags, No " around color codes
chinese: 纯文本|HTML 标签|论坛标签，颜色码带 ""|论坛标签，颜色码不带 ""

english: When checked, comments are color-coded for forum posts.
chinese: 勾选后，评论以颜色编码，便于论坛发帖。

english: Select which turn number 4000BC should be.
chinese: 选择公元前 4000 年应对应的回合数。

english: When checked, the logger inserts IBT (in between turns) at the end of the player's turn.
chinese: 勾选后，记录器在玩家回合结束时插入 IBT（回合之间）。

english: Used as a prefix before custom entries in the log (use [ALT + E]), e.g. your nick.
chinese: 用作日志中自定义条目（使用 [ALT + E]）的前缀，例如你的昵称。

english: When checked, will log techs acquired and research started.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录已获得的科技和已开始的研究。

english: When checked, will log when a city starts a build.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录城市开始建造的时刻。

english: When checked, will log when a city completes a build.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录城市完成建造的时刻。

english: When checked, will log completion of projects (certain wonders are technically projects -- other wonders are treated like normal buildings).
chinese: 勾选后，将记录工程的完成（某些奇观在技术上属于工程——其他奇观则按普通建筑处理）。

english: When checked, will log when your improvements are built or destroyed by you.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录你建造设施或由你摧毁设施的时刻。

english: When checked, will log when you found a city.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录你建立城市的时刻。

english: When checked, will log when one of your cities grows in population.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录你的某座城市人口增长的时刻。

english: When checked, will log when one of your city's borders expand.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录你某座城市边界扩张的时刻。

english: When checked, will log when you acquire or lose a city through conquest or trade.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录你通过征服或交易获得或失去城市的时刻。

english: When checked, will log when you raze another civ's city or one of your cities is razed.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录你摧毁其他文明城市，或你某座城市被摧毁的时刻。

english: When checked, will log when you whip a city or when the whip anger decreases in a city.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录你鞭策城市，或城市鞭策不满下降的时刻。

english: When checked, will log results from popping tribal villages.
chinese: 勾选后，将记录探索部落村庄的结果。

chinese: 勾选后，使用 BUG 财务顾问（需重启）。

chinese: 勾选后，在“异域外交顾问”界面显示“概览”选项卡。

english: Select how to display AI attitudes on the GLANCE tab: numbers, smilies, or both.
chinese: 选择在“概览”选项卡上显示 AI 态度的方式：数字、笑脸或两者。

english: When checked, uses improved Foreign Advisor 'Info' tab instead of default.
chinese: 勾选后，使用改进的外交顾问“信息”选项卡以替代默认版本。

english: When checked, shows how many turns are left before you can cancel each deal on the 'Active' tab.
chinese: 勾选后，在“活跃”选项卡上显示每笔交易还需多少回合才能取消。

english: When checked, uses the BUG Militiary Advisor (requires restart).
chinese: 勾选后，使用 BUG 军事顾问（需重启）。

english: When checked, displays the technology each type of great person will research.
chinese: 勾选后，显示每类伟人将会研究的科技。

english: When checked, some (WIP) advisors will be full-screen (requires restart).
chinese: 勾选后，部分（开发中的）顾问将全屏显示（需重启）。

english: When checked, the width of the tech screen will be linked to your screen resolution (requires restart).
chinese: 勾选后，科技界面的宽度将与你的屏幕分辨率联动（需重启）。

english: When selected, shows the technology's associated era.
chinese: 勾选后，显示科技所属的时代。

chinese: 勾选后，在“宗教”选项卡上显示额外信息。

chinese: 选择在宗教顾问顶部区域应显示哪些宗教。

english: When checked, displays extra information on the Victories tab.
chinese: 勾选后，在“胜利”选项卡上显示额外信息。

english: When checked, displays extra information on the Members tab.
chinese: 勾选后，在“成员”选项卡上显示额外信息。

chinese: 勾选后，以 BUG 格式显示图表。

chinese: 勾选后，图表以 Log(10) 对数刻度显示。

chinese: 勾选后，显示 BUG 版本的“奇观”选项卡。

english: When checked, displays wonders on the BUG version of the Wonders tab using the owning player's color.
chinese: 勾选后，在 BUG 版“奇观”选项卡上以拥有者玩家的颜色显示奇观。

english: When checked, displays improvements on Stats tab.
chinese: 勾选后，在“统计”选项卡上显示设施。

english: When checked, uses the Sevopedia (requires restart).
chinese: 勾选后，使用 Sevopedia（需重启）。

english: When checked, the lists of units, buildings, technologies, etc. are sorted.
chinese: 勾选后，单位、建筑、科技等列表将被排序。

english: When checked, the raw breakdowns for [ICON_FOOD], [ICON_PRODUCTION], and [ICON_COMMERCE] are displayed in the trade routes table.
chinese: 勾选后，在贸易路线表中显示 [ICON_FOOD]、[ICON_PRODUCTION] 和 [ICON_COMMERCE] 的原始明细。

english: Determines the Raw Yields view used when Civ is started.
chinese: 决定 Civ 启动时所用的“原始产出”视图。
贸易路线|食物|生产|商业

english: Select which tiles to count in Raw Yields when Civ is started.
chinese: 选择 Civ 启动时“原始产出”应计入哪些地块。

english: When checked, displays the food difference generated per turn (plus or minus) and the number of turns until starvation when the food supply is shrinking.
chinese: 勾选后，显示每回合产生的食物差额（正或负），并在食物供应缩减时显示距离饿死的回合数。

english: When checked, displays the [ICON_CITIZEN] cost and [ICON_PRODUCTION]/[ICON_GOLD] overflow for whipping and/or the [ICON_GOLD] cost for buying the item being produced in the Production Bar.
chinese: 勾选后，在生产条中显示鞭策的 [ICON_CITIZEN] 成本与 [ICON_PRODUCTION]/[ICON_GOLD] 溢出，和／或购买当前生产项目的 [ICON_GOLD] 成本。

english: When checked, whip production overflow estimates will include the city's current [ICON_PRODUCTION].
chinese: 勾选后，鞭策生产溢出估算将包含城市当前的 [ICON_PRODUCTION]。

english: When checked, displays the number of turns until the city's borders expand.
chinese: 勾选后，显示距离城市边界扩张的回合数。

english: When checked, displays the number of turns until the city will produce a [ICON_GREATPEOPLE].
chinese: 勾选后，显示距离城市产出一位 [ICON_GREATPEOPLE] 的回合数。

english: When checked, displays the percentage chance and type of each possible [ICON_GREATPEOPLE] on the bar. The number shown is controlled by the General setting.
chinese: 勾选后，在进度条上显示每种可能的 [ICON_GREATPEOPLE] 的类型及其出现的百分比几率。所显示的数量由“常规”设置控制。

english: When checked, puts anger countdown on city screen.
chinese: 勾选后，在城市界面显示不满倒计时。

english: When checked, displays only the religions that are present in the city and allows for more than seven religions.
chinese: 勾选后，仅显示城市中已存在的宗教，并允许显示超过七种宗教。

english: When checked, displays only the corporations that are present in the city and allows for more than seven corporations.
chinese: 勾选后，仅显示城市中已存在的企业，并允许显示超过七家企业。

english: Determines how specialists are displayed:[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Default[COLOR_REVERT] - Shows specialists using the vanilla BtS format.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Stacker[COLOR_REVERT] - Shows specialists stacked using the Stacked Specialist mod.[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Chevron[COLOR_REVERT] - Shows specialists grouped into 5 (single chevron), 10 (capped chevron) and 20 (boxed capped chevron) format.
chinese: 决定专家的显示方式：[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]默认[COLOR_REVERT] - 以原版 BtS 格式显示专家。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]堆叠[COLOR_REVERT] - 使用“堆叠专家”模组以堆叠方式显示专家。[NEWLINE][ICON_BULLET][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]V 形标记[COLOR_REVERT] - 将专家按 5 个（单 V 形）、10 个（封顶 V 形）和 20 个（带框封顶 V 形）分组显示。

english: When checked, displays the remaining turns in cyan for items that have been started.
chinese: 勾选后，对已开始的项目以青色显示其剩余回合数。

english: When checked, displays a yellow exclamation point (!) next to items in the build queue that are close to decaying from being left in the queue without adding [ICON_PRODUCTION] for too long. Two red exclamation points signify that the item will decay this turn if it is not first in the queue.
chinese: 勾选后，在建造队列中即将因长时间滞留、未增加 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 而衰减的项目旁显示一个黄色感叹号（!）。两个红色感叹号表示该项目若不排在队首，将在本回合衰减。

english: Select the number of turns before a unit will decay at which time a yellow exclamation mark is shown. Units decay after being in the queue without adding [ICON_PRODUCTION] for 10 turns.
chinese: 选择在单位衰减前多少回合显示黄色感叹号。单位在队列中滞留、10 回合未增加 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 后会衰减。

english: Select the number of turns before a building will decay at which time a yellow exclamation mark is shown. Buildings decay after being in the queue without adding [ICON_PRODUCTION] for 50 turns. Projects never decay.
chinese: 选择在建筑衰减前多少回合显示黄色感叹号。建筑在队列中滞留、50 回合未增加 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 后会衰减。工程永不衰减。

english: When checked, displays the number of turns before and amount of decay in the hover text for units and buildings in the build queue.
chinese: 勾选后，在建造队列中单位和建筑的悬浮提示里显示距衰减的回合数及衰减量。

english: Select the number of turns before a unit will decay at which time the decay information is first displayed.
chinese: 选择在单位衰减前多少回合首次显示衰减信息。

english: Select the number of turns before a building will decay at which time the decay information is first displayed.
chinese: 选择在建筑衰减前多少回合首次显示衰减信息。

english: When checked, selecting a civilian unit in the Choose Production popup sets the city to train that unit repeatedly.
chinese: 勾选后，在“选择生产”弹窗中选择某平民单位会使城市反复训练该单位。

english: When checked, selecting a military unit in the Choose Production popup sets the city to train that unit repeatedly.
chinese: 勾选后，在“选择生产”弹窗中选择某军事单位会使城市反复训练该单位。

english: Selects which logging messages get printed to the screen. Each level includes messages of all levels below it.
chinese: 选择哪些日志消息会打印到屏幕。每个级别都包含其下所有级别的消息。

english: Selects which logging messages get printed to the PythonDbg.log file. Each level includes messages of all levels below it.
chinese: 选择哪些日志消息会打印到 PythonDbg.log 文件。每个级别都包含其下所有级别的消息。

english: When checked, each log file message includes the current time in HH:MM:SS format.
chinese: 勾选后，每条日志文件消息都以 HH:MM:SS 格式包含当前时间。

english: When checked, BUG will look for SVN updates and/or releases each time you launch Civilization and notify you when new ones are found.
chinese: 勾选后，每次启动《文明》时，BUG 都会检查 SVN 更新和／或发布版本，并在发现新版本时通知你。

english: Location where BUG files are installed.
chinese: BUG 文件所在的安装位置。

english: Revision number of the BUG installation.
chinese: BUG 安装的修订版本号。

english: Revision number of the BUG repository.

chinese: 勾选后，在开始或载入游戏时显示一条关于 Alt + Ctrl + O 的提示消息。

english: When checked, shows the BUG Option Screen button.
chinese: 勾选后，显示 BUG 选项界面按钮。

english: When checked, displays your gold rate in yellow if it is negative but not enough to drop your treasury below zero.
chinese: 勾选后，当你的金钱收支为负、但尚不足以使国库跌破零时，以黄色显示收支。

english: When checked, displays the progress and city of the next Great Person.
chinese: 勾选后，显示下一位伟人的进度及所在城市。

english: Determines how many GP types to display in the GP Progress Bar. The [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Maximum[COLOR_REVERT] setting also displays the percent chance for each.
chinese: 决定在伟人进度条中显示多少种伟人类型。[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]最大[COLOR_REVERT] 设置还会显示每种的出现几率。

english: When checked, displays a progress bar for the next Great General.
chinese: 勾选后，显示下一位大将军的进度条。

english: When checked, displays a second pair of +/- buttons for each commerce type that set the rate to 100% and 0% respectively.
chinese: 勾选后，为每种商业类型显示第二对 +/- 按钮，分别将比率设为 100% 和 0%。

english: When checked, displays arrows to cycle through cities above your civ's flag.
chinese: 勾选后，在你文明的旗帜上方显示用于切换城市的箭头。

chinese: 勾选后，显示一个可用于调整视野范围的滑动条。

chinese: 勾选后，在选定的进度条上显示刻度标记，用以图示预估的未来回合进度。

chinese: 勾选后，视野范围的值将在每局游戏之间被记住。

english: Stores the Field of View value

english: *BUG Hint*: Press [ALT + CTRL + O] to enter The BUG Mod Options Screen.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：按 [ALT + CTRL + O] 进入 BUG 模组选项界面。

english: *BUG Hint*: Ever forget to build that Barracks?  [ALT +M] -OR- [ALT + CTRL + R] will allow you to set up reminders so you don't forget again!
chinese: *BUG 提示*：总是忘记建造那座兵营？[ALT +M] 或 [ALT + CTRL + R] 可让你设置提醒，从此不再遗漏！

english: *BUG Hint*: [ALT + S] allows you to make Sticky Notes on tiles.  Just click and type.  Pressing [ALT + S] again, and then clicking on an existing note will remove it.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：[ALT + S] 可让你在地块上贴便签。只需点击并输入。再次按 [ALT + S] 后点击现有便签即可将其移除。

english: *BUG Hint*: To cancel all Worker Orders quickly, select 1 worker with orders, and while holding the [ALT] key, click the cancel orders button.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：要快速取消所有工人指令，选中一个已有指令的工人，按住 [ALT] 键，点击取消指令按钮。

english: *BUG Hint*: [ALT + E] will allow you to make a custom Event in the autologger.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：[ALT + E] 可让你在自动记录器中创建一条自定义事件。

english: *BUG Hint*: Clicking on the Scroll button within the Domestic Advisor will allow you to customize it to your playing style.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：点击内政顾问中的卷轴按钮，可按你的游戏风格对其进行自定义。

english: *BUG Hint*: To create rally points, select the city, or cities, you are building units it, hold down the [SHIFT] key and Right Click on the tile you want your rally point to be at.  You will see a yellow circle showing the rally point.[NEWLINE]To cancel orders select the same city or cities, [SHIFT] and Right click on any city square, and it will cancel the rally orders.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：要设置集结点，选中你正在其中建造单位的城市（一座或多座），按住 [SHIFT] 键并右键点击你想设为集结点的地块。你会看到一个表示集结点的黄色圆圈。[NEWLINE]要取消指令，选中同一座或几座城市，按 [SHIFT] 并右键点击任意城市方格，即可取消集结指令。

english: *BUG Hint*: When a tile is in the City Cross of two different cities, you can change its city ownership by clicking on that tile from the chosen city's City Screen.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：当某地块位于两座不同城市的城市范围内时，你可以在所选城市的城市界面中点击该地块，从而更改其城市归属。

english: *BUG Hint*: When you're weak there is no shame in giving into rivals demands.  This will give you time to build your defenses as you enjoy the short improvement in relations between your nations.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：当你实力弱小时，向对手的要求让步并不可耻。这能为你争取时间构筑防御，同时享受两国关系短暂的改善。

english: *BUG Hint*: When at War, use fast moving units to pillage strategic resources such as Iron, or Aluminum first, and leave a sentry to prevent the enemy from reconnecting that resource.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：开战时，用快速移动的单位优先劫掠铁、铝等战略资源，并留下一名哨兵，防止敌人重新接通该资源。

english: *BUG Hint*: Save your promotions for when your unit is injured to speed up healing, and when you promote, use them to tailor your unit for the type of enemy you are facing.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：把晋升留到单位受伤时使用以加速治疗；晋升时，根据你所面对的敌人类型量身定制你的单位。

english: *BUG Hint*: Always consider having siege equipment before attacking a city.  A Swordsman can do more damage entering through a hole in the wall, then trying to climb over it with arrows raining down from above.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：进攻城市前，务必考虑先备好攻城器械。剑士从城墙缺口攻入所造成的伤害，远胜于顶着箭雨翻越城墙。

english: *BUG Hint*: Examine what resources are available before researching worker techs.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：在研究工人科技之前，先查看有哪些资源可用。

english: *BUG Hint*: Always consider escorting your Settlers.  It's mighty dangerous out in the Wilderness.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：务必考虑为你的移民护航。荒野之中，凶险万分。

english: *BUG Hint*: Play to your Civilization's traits, and specialize your Empire.  No use being Charismatic and Aggressive and never starting a war.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：善用你文明的特性，让你的帝国专精化。既是魅力型又是侵略型，却从不发动战争，那就毫无意义了。

english: *BUG Hint*: Selling resources that you no longer use, such as copper or iron, can pay off nicely over the long run.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：出售你不再使用的资源（如铜或铁），长远来看能带来可观的回报。

english: *BUG Hint*: Don't neglect your Diplomacy!  Pay attention to the information you gather, telling you what is available out there.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：别忽视你的外交！留意你所收集的情报，它会告诉你外界有哪些机会。

english: *BUG Hint*: Be the first to circle the globe, and your Naval Units all receive +1 movement.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：率先环游世界，你的所有海军单位都将获得 +1 移动力。

english: *BUG Hint*: Animals can't enter your land, so it can be worth the risk to leave your city undefended and use your warrior for early exploration.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：动物无法进入你的领土，因此冒险让城市不设防、用战士进行早期探索，或许是值得的。

english: *BUG Hint*: Form trade relations with nations that get along with each other to avoid an diplomatic repercussions.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：与彼此关系融洽的国家建立贸易关系，以避免外交上的负面影响。

english: *BUG Hint*: If you neglect your military, and your power becomes weak, a neighbor WILL attack you.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：若你疏于军备、实力变弱，邻国必将来犯。

english: *BUG Hint*: Station naval units near your water based resources, and put them on Sea Patrol to protect your resources.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：把海军单位驻扎在你的水域资源附近，让它们执行海上巡逻以保护你的资源。

english: *BUG Hint*: When selling Technologies, shop around for the highest bidder, and then work your way down.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：出售科技时，货比三家，先找出价最高的买家，再逐级往下谈。

english: *BUG Hint*: Watch your neighbors' civics changes.  A change from Free Religion to Theocracy could mean an arms build-up.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：留意邻国的政策变动。由自由宗教转为神权，可能意味着军备扩张。

english: *BUG Hint*: Speak softly and carry a big stick, and you will go far.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：说话温和，手持大棒，你便能走得长远。

english: *BUG Hint*: Sometimes it's better to stop a Scout or Explorer on a forest, hill, or jungle tile and lose the extra movement in favor of safety.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：有时，让斥候或探险家停在森林、丘陵或丛林地块上，以损失额外移动力换取安全，反而更好。

english: *BUG Hint*: Never go up against a Sicilian when death is on the line.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：性命攸关之时，切莫与西西里人作对。

english: *BUG Hint*: Be nice to your mother.
chinese: *BUG 提示*：要对你的母亲好一点。

english: *BUG Hint*: The cake is a lie.
Reset all options back to mod defaults (game effect is immediate but reload BUG options screen to visually confirm)
chinese: 将所有选项重置回模组默认值（游戏内立即生效，但需重新加载 BUG 选项界面才能在视觉上确认）
